meta-description: See local heat and air by place and time. Check each reading in a map, list, or table.
meta-description-openaq: See air sensor data from OpenAQ in California. Swelter has not checked these readings, so it marks them as provisional.
meta-description-openmeteo: See air model data for California from CAMS and Open-Meteo. These are model values, not local sensor readings.
meta-description-sensor-community: See low-cost sensor data from Sensor.Community near Stuttgart. Swelter has not checked these readings, so it marks them as provisional.
meta-description-synthetic: See sample heat and air data when live sources are down. These are not real sensor readings.
tagline: Local heat and air. Check each reading's source and status.
now-intro: Find a place. Then open the facts behind its reading.
now-provisional-note: This reading is not checked yet. Check official alerts too.
now-empty: No reading is shown for this measure and time.
now-search-empty: No matching place has this measure at this time.
now-no-reading: No reading was published for this location at {$time}.
now-gap: This gap stays blank. Swelter does not guess a value or use another place.
observation-stale: The newest reading is from {$time}. It may be out of date.
explore-heading: See place, time, and evidence together
explore-intro: Every view is linked. Change the hour, select a place, or adjust the evidence window and the map, ranking, and evidence panel stay in step.
range-note: This window shows published readings. It may not have one for each hour. Swelter leaves missing times blank.
braid-key: Line shows reading. Band shows range. Hatch means provisional.
braid-instructions: Use Left and Right Arrow to change the selected observation. Home and End jump to the edges of the evidence window. You can also click or tap anywhere in the plot to choose the nearest observation.
braid-selected-gap: {$time}. {$place}: no published reading at this observation.
braid-selected-empty: {$time}. No place has this measure at this time.
braid-se-note: For number data, the band shows the published range around each reading. It is not a confidence range.
braid-exposure-note: Method note: “{$note}”. Heat + air is a ranked level, so it has no number range.
braid-no-band: No number range was published for this measure. The line still shows each reading.
braid-empty: Choose a place with past readings.
braid-summary: {$place}: {$n} readings from {$start} to {$end}. Low {$min}; middle {$median}; high {$max}. Provisional: {$provisional}. Gaps: {$gaps}.
braid-all-provisional: No checked history is ready. Use this provisional line as a rough guide.
distribution-note: Choose a bar to link its place in each view. Checked readings rank first. If none exist, rough readings appear with a clear label. The printed value and rank are the source of truth. Clear the search to see all places.
distribution-empty: No place has this measure at this time.
distribution-search-empty: No matching place has this measure at this time.
distribution-search-empty-confirmed: No matching checked reading was found. Rough readings were left out.
inspector-empty: Choose a place in any view. You can then check its trend, range, source, and next steps.
network-intro: See sensor coverage, public alerts, and places that may need help.
method-intro: Each reading keeps its source, check status, range, privacy note, and reuse terms.
locate-denied: Location not shared — search by name instead.
locate-unavailable: This device can't share a location — search by name instead.
health-status: Sensor status at {$time}: {$ok} good · {$degraded} weak · {$offline} offline.
overview-none-confirmed: No checked readings yet. All readings here are provisional.
overview-all-provisional-stats: All values are provisional; this range is rough.
fresh-stale: This network may be behind — readings are not live.
offline-note: You're offline — showing the last readings this device loaded. Reconnect for the latest.
map-hint: This map shows each sensor place. Drag or use arrow keys to move. Scroll, pinch, or use the buttons to zoom. Each marker has text. The List and Table show the same data.
map-aria: Sensor locations. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom, arrow keys to move.
spark-label: {$n} published observations from {$start} to {$end} — low {$low}, high {$high}{$unit}.
spark-all-provisional: All chart points are provisional. Use this as a rough shape.
headline-none: No checked air readings at this time. Only provisional data is ready.
guide-good: Air quality is good. It's a fine time to be active outside.
guide-moderate: Air is fair. Very sensitive people may want less long or hard work outside.
guide-usg: People with heart or lung disease, older people, and kids may feel sick. They should do less outside. Others may not feel it.
guide-unhealthy: Some people may feel effects; sensitive groups may feel more serious ones. Consider shorter or less intense time outdoors.
guide-vu: Health alert: anyone may feel sick. Sensitive people should stay in. Others should do less outside.
guide-haz: Health warning: everyone should avoid hard work outside.
guide-source-heat: Heat context: US NWS heat index.
guide-source-both: Health context: US EPA AirNow and US NWS heat index.
act-note: Practical steps drawn from US EPA and NWS guidance — not medical advice.
act-calm: This level does not call for special steps. Conditions can change fast. Check official alerts and note how you feel.
act-heat-water: Drink water before you feel thirsty.
act-heat-shade: Take breaks in shade or air conditioning.
act-heat-easy: Avoid hard work at the hottest time of day.
act-heat-cool: Limit time outside and stay somewhere cool.
act-heat-signs: Watch for dizziness, nausea, or cramps — early signs of heat illness.
act-heat-neighbors: Check on older people, kids, and people without cool indoor air.
act-heat-ac: Get to air conditioning — a library, cooling center, or store all count.
act-heat-emergency: Hot dry skin, confusion, or fainting can mean heat stroke. Call for help now.
act-air-sensitive: If bad air affects you fast, do less long or hard work outside.
act-air-groups: People with asthma, heart or lung disease, older adults, and kids should do less outside.
act-air-inhaler: Keep your fast-acting medicine close if you use it.
act-air-cutback: Cut back on time and effort outdoors.
act-air-windows: Keep windows closed; run an air filter if you have one.
act-air-mask: A well-fitting N95 or KN95 helps if you must be outside.
act-air-indoors: Stay indoors with windows closed if you can.
heat-guide-caution: Caution: fatigue is possible with prolonged time outside or activity. Take breaks, find shade, and drink water.
heat-guide-xcaution: Take great care: heat cramps or heat illness may start. Do less, rest in shade, and drink water often.
heat-guide-danger: Danger: heat illness is likely and heat stroke can start. Do not work hard. Stay cool and check on others.
heat-guide-xdanger: Great danger: heat stroke is very likely. Stay inside in cool air. Check on people at risk.
context-top-hot: The hottest place in the network now.
context-top-bad: The worst in the network at this observation.
context-rank-bad: {$n} of {$total} locations are worse at this observation.
yesterday-same: About the same as this time yesterday.
prov-derived: Combined from this area's heat and air readings.
compare-worse: {$a} is worse than {$b} at this observation.
compare-better: {$a} is better than {$b} at this observation.
compare-same: {$a} and {$b} are about the same at this observation.
compare-provisional: One or both readings are provisional. Treat this as a rough check.
alerts-note: Alerts check only the newest reading while this page is open. There is no account or push task. Your device will not alert you when that reading is old.
alert-line: {$place}: at {$time}, {$param} was {$reading} — at or past your alert level of {$threshold}.
alert-provisional: This reading is still provisional (not yet calibrated), so treat it as rough.
alert-stale: This reading is old. Check current conditions before you act.
alert-observation-unavailable: The reading from {$time} is not loaded. Swelter did not show a different time.
notify-body: Observation at {$time}: {$reading} — at or past your alert level of {$threshold}.
aa-intro: These places passed a danger level for heat or air. Each result shows its time. The data has no account or tracking.
aa-none: No danger-level heat or air alerts in the published feed as of {$time}.
aa-stale: This feed is old. Check current conditions before you act.
aa-heat: {$area}: heat index was in the {$sev} range at {$time}.
aa-exposure: {$area}: combined heat + air exposure was {$sev} at {$time}.
aa-prov: Still provisional. Treat this as rough.
aa-copied: Feed link copied — paste it into any RSS/Atom reader to subscribe.
aa-copy-fail: Couldn't copy — the alert feed is at /api/alerts.xml.
aa-note: Add this feed to an RSS reader or another tool. It is public and has no personal data. Its levels follow US EPA and NWS bands.
aa-es-feed-note: A machine wrote the Spanish feed text. A person has not checked it.
cooling-intro: These public places offer cool indoor air. The list has the same places as the map.
cooling-show: Show cooling centers on the map
cooling-hide: Hide cooling centers on the map
cooling-shown: Cooling centers are now shown on the map.
cooling-hidden: Cooling centers are hidden on the map.
cool-distance: about {$km} km from the selected location
watch-intro: Set a level for this measurement. While this page is open, you'll see an alert here when this location reaches it. Saved on this device only — no account, no server.
watch-number-label: Alert at this reading or higher
watch-need-value: Enter a number to alert at first.
notify-granted: Device alerts are on in this browser.
notify-blocked: Device alerts are off. Alerts on this page still work.
copy-fail: Couldn't copy — copy the address bar instead.
brief-done: Summary copied. Paste it into an email, flyer, or public note.
brief-source: Source: swelter sensor network. Open CC0 data.
brief-network: Copy a summary of the whole network
brief-network-done: Network summary copied. Paste it into a story, report, or public note.
share-card-window: This is the place's mean for this hour, not a full-day mean.
share-card-fail: Couldn't create the share card image.
legend-wbgt-note: This heat stress value is an estimate from air heat and moisture. It has no black-globe or sun sensor, so it may read too cool in full sun. Each value says ‘estimated.’ Use the List or Table to check every place.
heat-band-note: Color shows cool to hot. The number on each marker is the reading in your chosen unit.
exp-level-minimal: Minimal — little added heat or air stress
exp-level-high: High — limit time and exertion outdoors
legend-value-note: Each marker shows the measured value, not a risk group. A higher number means more of the pollutant. Use the List or Table to check every place.
what-is-aqi-body: The Air Quality Index (AQI) puts air harm on a scale from 0 to 500. A higher number is worse. Good is 0 to 50. At 101, some people may feel harm.
aqi-window: AQI uses this place's one-hour mean, not a full-day mean.
provisional: Provisional places have early readings that are not checked yet. They never look confirmed. Text and pattern show this status, not color alone.
exp-note: Heat + air uses the worse level from heat or PM2.5 air. It also flags when both are high. This is a guide, not a health test or a claim that you are safe.
how-to-read: How to read this — and what it does not say
method-calibration: A confirmed sensor was checked by a trusted monitor. A sensor with no check stays provisional.
method-uncertainty: Each confirmed reading shows its published range.
method-location: Published locations snap to a ~150 m grid, so the map shows the area, not the porch.
method-aqi: AQI uses this place's one-hour mean, not the official full-day mean.
method-exposure: Heat + air exposure takes the higher of the heat and air levels — it never blends them into one number.
method-open: Reuse terms and attribution depend on the active source and are shown above. Readings are downloadable without an account or key.
trust-summary: Confirmed readings were checked against a trusted monitor and show a range. Provisional readings were not checked yet. This page does not say you are safe. Note how you feel and check official alerts too.
trust-safety: These readings do not tell anyone they are safe. Use them alongside how you feel and official advisories.
footer-data: Reuse terms for the active source are shown above. Download the full history — no account, no key.
footer-note: Each reading shows if it was checked. Checked readings also show a range.
settings-intro: swelter keeps your choices in this browser only — no account, no server. That's your language, units, text size, contrast, any alert thresholds you set, and the last location you opened.
settings-empty: Nothing is saved on this device yet.
settings-cleared: Saved settings cleared from this device.
no-data: No data yet. Run `swelter demo --serve` or `make demo`.
